content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Same business: online car marketplace selling listings, dealer advertising and software to franchised and independent dealers."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Claims and total-loss software for insurers and repair shops, not dealer listings or advertising."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Voice AI software licensed to automakers; no marketplace, dealer customers or advertising business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Insurance quote marketplace selling leads to insurers and agencies, not automotive dealer listings."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Insurance and memberships for classic car enthusiasts; its marketplace is secondary to insurance and publications."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Local newspaper publisher selling print and digital ads and subscriptions; not an automotive marketplace."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Point-of-sale hardware and payments for restaurants and retailers; different products and customers."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Wholesale vehicle auctions and dealer floorplan lending; sells used vehicles rather than dealer listings and software."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Programmatic ad-buying platform for brands and agencies; no automotive dealer marketplace or dealer software."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Cannabis consumer marketplace with dealer software and ads; similar model but a different industry and customers."}]}
